title: Basilica of Sainte-Anne-de-Beaupré

terrainReference.basis: Native Copernicus GLO-30 at the lower front plaza just beyond the main stairs. The modern terrain remains unchanged and the foundation extends below it.

mapIdentity.scope: The mapped perimeter controls the nave, tower base, transept and lower chapel alignment. The shrine’s published dimensions cross-check the near-100m length and widths, and the Québec inventory confirms the spires exceed 90m.

note: The native front and south originals show the vertical section, tower and facade proportions, lower and higher fenestration, roof textures and small chapels. The shrine and provincial inventory specify coverings, pointed roof treatment and sculpture placement.
